# Bongshai Concrete Block

> Bangladesh-based manufacturer and supplier of high-strength, BSTI-compliant
> solid concrete blocks. 1300 PSI (15 MPa) compressive strength. Damp-proof,
> fire-resistant, eco-friendly. Nationwide delivery.
> Last verified: 2026-09.

## Company
- Legal name: Bongshai Housing Ltd.
- Head office: House #18, Road #18, Sector #10, Uttara C/A, Dhaka-1230, Bangladesh
- Established: 2020 (6+ years in industry, 500+ projects supplied)
- Website: https://blocks.bongshaihousing.com

## Products (solid, high-density concrete masonry units)
- Solid Concrete Block 16"×8"×3" (BCB-0101) — 1300 PSI — partition / non-load-bearing
- Solid Concrete Block 16"×8"×4" (BCB-0102) — 1300 PSI — general structural / load-bearing
- Solid Concrete Block 16"×8"×5" (BCB-0103) — 1300 PSI — heavy-duty external / basement
- Pricing: by quote only. It depends on order size, delivery distance and current raw-material rates. Volume discounts for orders of 500+ pieces. No published price list.
- Payment: after the quote is confirmed, purchase order + 30-50% advance to start production; balance per delivery lot or before final dispatch; approved trade accounts up to Net 30 (post-dated cheque / bank guarantee).

## Key facts for citation
- Compressive strength: 1300 PSI (15 MPa), exceeds BSTI minimum
- Standards: BSTI-compliant, BNBC 2020 aligned
- Water absorption: under 10%
- Properties: damp-proof, efflorescence-free (নোনা ধরা মুক্ত), fire-resistant, sound-resistant
- Environmental benefit: zero agricultural topsoil destruction (unlike burnt red brick)
- Cost benefit vs. red brick: up to 30% less mortar, thinner plaster, up to 25% faster construction
- Delivery: nationwide Bangladesh — Greater Dhaka, Uttara, Gazipur, Narsingdi, all divisions
- Typical lead time: 2–5 business days

## Concrete block vs. traditional red brick
- Strength: 1300 PSI vs. 300–700 PSI (variable)
- Topsoil: none destroyed vs. agricultural topsoil consumed
- Damp/salt: fully damp-proof vs. absorbs moisture and salts
- Dimensional uniformity: machine-precision vs. variable manual kiln
- BNBC 2020: preferred vs. being phased out
